description: Candidate target shapes for ZenoDEX. These are aspirational comparison points for ShapeForge, not required baseline truths.

target_shapes.name: Shape++
target_shapes.description: Aspirational target shape for ZenoDEX that compresses CBC validity, canonicality, exact accounting, settlement assurance, oracle boundaries, liquidation containment, and replay parity into one candidate attractor.

clauses.label: CBCValidity
clauses.notes: Currently instantiated strongly on the batch ValidOutcome surface rather than as a system-wide CBC theorem.

clauses.label: UniqueCanonicalWinnerEverywhere
clauses.notes: This asks for optimizer canonicality as a proof-level property, not merely deterministic iteration order or contract-level surfaces. The promoted exact-out slice is now explicitly scoped to the repaired bounded audited lane; broader global generator-completeness negatives remain tracked separately in negative knowledge rather than blocking this bounded promoted target.

clauses.label: ExactFeeAwareAccounting
clauses.notes: This target now has separate proved support from fee dust carry, fee-aware same-pool dominance, fee-aware batch K-gap telescoping, and core CPMM safety, but it is still not one universal fee-aware theorem for every execution layer.

clauses.label: ValueAwareSettlementSafety
clauses.notes: The target now has a proved settlement-certificate boundary: the live settlement-certificate posture routes through one replayable end-to-end packet that unifies the replay-bound strong certificate, a replayable feature-extension packet, full-price-rails enforcement, and the explicit value lane, with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks for the feature-extension and end-to-end packet gates. The LP-free explicit-price spot-value sublane, LP-aware sidecars, endogenous LP packet, bounded provenance packet, and optional signed attestation still matter for scope, but the missing blocker is no longer absence of a single end-to-end certificate object.

clauses.label: ProofCarryingOptimizerCertificates
clauses.notes: This asks for promoted optimizer and settlement surfaces to remain proof-carrying at the public runtime boundary. Exact-in now has an explicit rank-projection packet, true-key-interpretation packet, oracle-contract packet, and guarded quote surface with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks across those public boundary artifacts. Exact-out many-pool now has a core-aligned selected-domain canonical winner, a replayable prefilter contract with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks, a repaired-prefilter contract plus repaired advisory-quote packet with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks, a repaired full-domain certified packet that preserves the full bounded feasible-domain canonical certificate at the advisory boundary, repaired key-cover and interpretation packets, selected-domain support/bridge theorems, and a unified certified-winner packet above its bounded candidate-domain and guarded-quote layers. The weaker prefilter-contraction bridge remains negative knowledge for the old heuristic, and broader global generator-completeness negatives remain tracked separately outside this bounded promoted target. Settlement now has a proved packetized boundary for the settlement-certificate posture: a replayable feature-extension packet, a unified end-to-end certificate packet with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks, and a live runtime path that routes require_settlement_certificate through that packet.

clauses.label: AntiFragmentationByTheorem
clauses.notes: Current support is explicit on both zero-fee and fee-aware same-pool same-direction proved domains; broader cross-pool or heterogeneous-rate fragmentation claims remain outside this clause.

clauses.label: NonCommutativityQuarantine
clauses.notes: This is a negative guardrail clause: opposite-direction shared-reserve steps must preserve explicit order.

clauses.label: OracleDivergenceSafety
clauses.notes: This clause combines module-local pending-mismatch safety with cross-module divergence bounds when deployments share economic assumptions.

clauses.label: LiquidationSpiralContainment
clauses.notes: This target is presently best read through bounded-move solvency and deterministic liquidation posture rather than a fully general spiral theorem.

clauses.label: CrossLayerReplayParity
clauses.notes: This is an assurance-shape clause: replay parity must match the declared semantic source rank of active Tau specs.

target_shapes.name: DEX Kernel Assurance
target_shapes.description: Focused target shape for DEX optimizer canonicality, exact accounting, theorem-scoped anti-fragmentation, and proof-carrying optimizer boundaries.

clauses.label: CBCValidity
clauses.notes: Kernel posture wants the batch validity surface as a proved baseline.

clauses.label: UniqueCanonicalWinnerEverywhere
clauses.notes: The DEX kernel ideal wants all promoted optimizer winners to be proved canonical under one explicit total key. The exact-out side is now satisfied on the repaired bounded audited lane; broader generator-completeness negatives remain tracked separately rather than blocking this bounded promoted target.

clauses.label: ExactFeeAwareAccounting
clauses.notes: Kernel posture now uses fee dust carry plus dedicated fee-aware same-pool and fee-aware batch K-gap proofs as the baseline exactness law, rather than only the older partial carry theorem.

clauses.label: ProofCarryingOptimizerCertificates
clauses.notes: The DEX kernel target wants optimizer and settlement outputs to remain proof-carrying at the public boundary. The exact-out side is now satisfied on the repaired bounded audited lane; broader generator-completeness negatives remain tracked separately rather than blocking this bounded promoted target.

clauses.label: AntiFragmentationByTheorem
clauses.notes: This remains explicitly scoped to the proved same-pool same-direction domains, now including both zero-fee and fee-aware CPMM execution.

clauses.label: NonCommutativityQuarantine
clauses.notes: The kernel target keeps opposite-direction shared-reserve steps behind an explicit order quarantine.

target_shapes.name: Runtime Boundary Assurance
target_shapes.description: Focused target shape for settlement, oracle synchronization, replay parity, and public certificate surfaces at the runtime boundary.

clauses.label: ValueAwareSettlementSafety
clauses.notes: The target now has a proved settlement-certificate boundary: the live settlement-certificate posture routes through one replayable end-to-end packet that unifies the replay-bound strong certificate, a replayable feature-extension packet, full-price-rails enforcement, and the explicit value lane, with Lean- and ESSO-backed shell checks for the feature-extension and end-to-end packet gates. The LP-free explicit-price spot-value sublane, LP-aware sidecars, endogenous LP packet, bounded provenance packet, and optional signed attestation still matter for scope, but the missing blocker is no longer absence of a single end-to-end certificate object.

clauses.label: ProofCarryingOptimizerCertificates
clauses.notes: Runtime posture wants optimizer/settlement certificates to be first-class public packets, not only local internals. Exact-out many-pool now has a default-facing certified-advisory boundary, guarded and certified packet stacks, repaired full-domain and key-cover certificate layers, and replayable mismatch contracts on failure. Broader generator-completeness negatives remain tracked separately outside this bounded promoted runtime target.

clauses.label: OracleDivergenceSafety
clauses.notes: Boundary posture treats module-local and cross-module oracle mismatch as one fail-closed sync law.

clauses.label: CrossLayerReplayParity
clauses.notes: Runtime parity means the active Tau surface tracks its declared semantic source rank, not only review-packet parity.

clauses.label: NonCommutativityQuarantine
clauses.notes: Boundary posture still depends on explicit order quarantine where shared-reserve steps are not commutative.
